triples.tail_surface: standby pump capable of serving all engines is to be installed
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 安装能服务所有发动机的备用泵
triples.evidence_text: Where auxiliary diesel engines are provided with a common fuel oil service pump or similar, a standby pump capable of serving all engines is to be installed.

triples.tail_surface: provision for a standby pump is to be in accordance with 4-6-5/3.5.1
triples.evidence_text: Where pumps are provided for fuel injector cooling, the provision for a standby pump is to be in accordance with 4-6-5/3.5.1.

triples.tail_surface: arranged such that they can be cleaned without interrupting the power supply
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 布置成可在不中断供电的情况下进行清洗
triples.evidence_text: Where common filters or strainers are provided to serve the fuel oil injection-pump suction lines of all the generator engines, they are to be arranged such that they can be cleaned without interrupting the power supply specified in 4-8-2/3.1.1.

triples.head_surface: Piping between the service pump and the combustors
triples.head_canonical_zh: 供给泵与燃烧器之间的管路
triples.evidence_text: Piping between the service pump and the combustors are to be effectively jacketed or shielded as in 4-6-5/3.3.6 or 4-6-5/3.3.7, respectively.

triples.tail_surface: quick closing device which will automatically shut off fuel supply
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 自动切断燃油供应的快速关闭装置
triples.evidence_text: Each gas turbine is to be fitted with a quick closing device which will automatically shut off fuel supply upon sensing malfunction in its operation
